scope: All top-level Code.gs functions, late overrides, constants, declared capability flags and both embedded extractor programs. Available means implemented/source-traced, not certified against every live course or production account.

bootstrap.note: React and /api/session replace HtmlService and bootstrap. Build timestamps and a truthful application-wide capability/health view are not implemented; the copied engine manifest describes the old product, not current availability.

extractor-endpoint.note: Local generated extractor delivery replaces google.script.run. Full helper, literal-constant and execution-code parity checked independently.

unused-helpers.note: No call sites in the archived production Code.gs/Index.html. Retained only as reference helpers; not counted as working application features.

auth.note: Cloudflare Access identity and editor/admin authorization replace Apps Script session/properties. Local mode is explicitly per-browser.

workbook-registration.note: In-memory registered workbook IDs and selected saved workbooks replace Drive IDs and user properties.

metadata-validation.note: Record shape and UI status choices are validated, but the old server-side status/date/Drive-link restrictions and date/link editing are not equivalent.

versions.note: Versioned saves use IndexedDB transactions or atomic D1 conditional commits with immutable audit snapshots.

semantic-package-identity.note: The new-record path uses a random UUID without the old partner+semantic-filename duplicate guard, download-suffix normalization, or DEV/B0RL normalization.

analytics-cache.note: Portfolio metrics are recalculated from refreshed records; no Apps Script cache needs invalidation.

catalog-sync.note: No current NAIT/Marshall catalog input, matching or catalog-driven owner/title refresh. Exported Catalog_Map tables remain in migration backups only.

planner-queue.note: The current Work queue is a course list and evidence checklist. It does not implement planner date campaigns, title-slot reconciliation, owner disambiguation, audit-first next actions, or the original workflow state machine.

work-state.note: Checklist booleans and notes can be imported/edited/versioned. Scope, Coursera Redo, Course Outline, Source Audit, Specialization Outline and Content Map states remain in legacyRow without a current state-machine UI.

scan-history.note: Full source record revisions are retained and shared revisions can be reopened; legacy scan history remains in the backup. Queue freshness checks and source-scan IDs in automatic longitudinal metadata are not ported.

storage.note: Checksummed chunked D1 records/local IndexedDB and the loss-aware migration importer replace spreadsheet discovery, tree cells/chunks and schema migration. No Google runtime service is required.

generation-memory.note: First valid raw baseline, generation isolation, provenance memory, exact replay and stage guards are implemented. The old explicit import-event provenance, destination-ID-change warnings, parent/source-scan links and automatic stage/reimport summary deltas are not fully implemented.

lineage-repair.note: No operator-confirmed, conservative repair path for the old v6.12.0 repeated-export misclassification. Imported original metadata is retained, not repaired.

saved-history.note: Full immutable reports can be saved, reopened, downloaded and compared. Original lineage/review metadata is retained in imports; specialized repair/longitudinal features are separately marked partial/gap.

duplicate-cleanup.note: No preview/token-checked conflict-aware merge/archive workflow. Original code chose a stable survivor UUID, kept newest scan evidence, preserved metadata and archived pre-merge rows; keeping this code in archive does not provide the feature.

telemetry.note: No equivalent persisted total-visit/last-visit counter. It is not evidence logic, but was an available feature.

package-writes.note: Save, rescan and edit owner/partner/status work with version checks and preserved revisions. Semantic duplicate prevention and the complete old metadata editing/validation contract are missing.

package-delete.note: No delete/archive method in WorkspaceStore, corresponding API route, or current catalogue action.

portfolio.note: Core IFS, workload estimate and profile/cosine functions are retained. Partner aggregate totals, catalog owner refresh and duplicate summary are not ported.

source-analysis.note: Browser package scanner invokes the retained analyzeImsccCore_ with explicit byte/XML services.

manifest-export.note: Source scan JSON is downloadable, but no equivalent Level/Name/Assignment_Tool/System Format/Ingestion Status manifest table export exists. A Google dependency is not necessary to restore an XLSX equivalent.

workbook-io.note: Local XLSX adapters replace Drive conversion/temp files. Scan/split/validation rules are unchanged; Spec downloads retain export, Module Context, Time Policy and Excluded Modules sheets.

preflight.note: The deterministic no-valid-items / core-empty-folders / >50-LTI preflight verdict and explanation are not exposed. Source statistics alone are not an equivalent.

advisory.note: No replacement for Gemini advisory triage or the bounded deterministic deep-architecture summary/advisory endpoint. Advisory text must remain separate from evidence verdicts.

health.note: No current operator-facing aggregated registry/extractor/storage/runtime health check. CI and /api/session cover only parts of the old feature.

lifecycle.note: Saved report pairs replace four-file entry. Same-generation raw/current uses the identical delta engine; other comparisons are explicitly observational. This audit restores entry-point incoherence and full-capture checks. Automatic lineage deltas remain a separate partial feature.

runtime-inventory.note: Saved external SCORM/Rise evidence is imported and consumed; source-package/live-source runtime policies remain. No fresh inventory refresh/import workflow; missing inventory is explicitly warned.

comparison-entry.note: Explicit per-comparison workbook/source/history/runtime services call the preserved full QA core. Full result JSON and owner report are saved.

remediation.note: The old deterministic HTML category list is replaced by complete owner reports and per-item actions, including missing, exclusions, repackaging, manual removal, mutations, partial/moved/unverified and extras. Core owner-action decisions are preserved.

migration-export.note: The old exporter is needed once in the old Google deployment. Current Cloudflare supports workspace backups and imports complete original tables/chunks; exported but unused data is not counted as a working feature.
